title: Manhood
tagline: Men Supporting Men, an app to learn to be a Man thanks to Steve Biddulph
description: This project is inspired by my own transition into manhood and finding the book "Manhood" by Steve Biddulph and realizing the importance of his ideas. I think many men would benefit from the concepts shared in the book so I decided to make an app facilitating the process. A mini app inside of the World App where users have to prove they're human and also tip a small fee to learn and gain knowledge about men.
how_its_made: Manhood, built with Next.js 16, combines AI mentorship with World ID verification. We process Steve Biddulph’s book into text chunks, convert them into embeddings using OpenAI’s text-embedding-3-small, and store them in a custom SQLite vector database. When users ask questions, GPT-4o-mini retrieves relevant passages via cosine similarity and streams real-time responses, giving advice grounded in the book while keeping the system fast, private, and cost-efficient.
